purpose: Bounded executable program delivery through the shared036module; live gateway and real GPU save with explicit total runtime protection
formal_mode: KAGGLE_IS_COMPETITION_RERUN supplied by Kaggle; live COMPETITION gateway only
formal_submission_file_owner: Kaggle gateway; notebook never writes scores in a competition rerun

official_save_protocol.scope: Official placeholder is emitted only after the real GPU save smoke passes. The gateway alone writes the formal rerun submission; smoke is not a leaderboard score.

save_smoke.validation: Each game has non-RESET actions > 0, generated tokens > 0, and state won/cancelled; health must have returned 200
save_smoke.cleanup: Only the process group of the model Popen started by this save

kernel_owner_provenance.basis: Repository owner and recorded competition team; target identity is a configuration pending a live account check
kernel_owner_provenance.quota_note: No historical balance is treated as current quota; query live quota and existing jobs before any launch

formal_runtime_budget.runtime_change: Replace009 formal soft_end=None with one total deadline including input setup, cold loading and gateway waiting; clamp the per-game limit to the actual remaining time
formal_runtime_budget.limit: The first-cell clock cannot measure platform work before execution; the cleanup reserve remains conservative headroom

bounded_executable_plan.scope: Only local program-delivery branches; the ordinary actor retains its original model, thinking, prompts and tools

research_transfer_risks: A same-prefix diagnostic is not evidence of natural trigger coverage, full-pool improvement or hidden-score gain.
Full25 research uses a shorter public OFFLINE allocation; formal runtime enumerates the actual live gateway and counts cold loading in one nine-hour cap.
The explicit formal total deadline,300s cleanup reserve and120s cancel-drain bound are runtime changes from009, not alleged observed performance improvements.
Nonthinking branch delivery and reduced context may lose useful task hypotheses; complete code and pixel acceptance do not certify the inferred rule.
Save health and real-game actions validate execution, not leaderboard quality. Only a real competition submission ID and its official result establish a scored attempt.
Research may retain in-flight server work after a cancelled CPU arm; bounded cache waiting is used between arms. It is not a claim that all server requests are always cancelled immediately.
